title: Gemi Arslanı
author: Ercüment Ekrem Talu
description: Ercüment Ekrem Talu’s classic novel follows the journey of an orphaned boy whose mother, Mrs. Şerefnaz, strives to secure a promising future for her seemingly unpromising son, Sudi. Set against the rich backdrop of old Istanbul, the story explores love, family, social change, and the pursuit of happiness. Poverty tests both mother and son, and the appearance of the captivating Leman invites readers to reflect on the many paths to fulfillment. Through his vivid portrayal of Istanbul’s poor neighborhoods, nuanced character studies, and masterful use of language, Talu demonstrates the art of novel-writing nearly a century ago.
